answer: Make every agent lock a refundable stake before earning, with rewards released only after a delayed settlement window. A sybil operator must fund each fake identity separately, so a thousand hollow shells cost a thousand stakes, while honest agents get theirs back. During the window a random audit panel can demand any agent re-derive its work from a fresh seed: replayed answers wander across identities but fail, since each must show its own computation. Honest history compounds like rings in a cedar: long-lived agents earn growing trust, while fresh identities start at zero.
